msft.text: Microsoft fell 35.5% in pounds from Dec 2007 to Feb 2009, leaving £10,000 invested at the high worth £6,450 at the low.

aapl.text: Apple fell 41.5% in pounds from Dec 2007 to Dec 2008.

nvda.text: Nvidia’s value in pounds fell 72.5% from Sep 2007 to Nov 2008, and its annual volatility was 46.1%.

sgln.text: The physical gold fund fell 38.2% in pounds from Aug 2011 to Jul 2015.

iglt.text: The fund fell 31.9% from May 2020 to Oct 2023 and remained 25.9% below its high at the end of Aug 2026.

azn.text: AstraZeneca fell 41.0% from Aug 2006 to Mar 2008, spending 43 months below its previous high before recovering.

btc.text: Bitcoin’s volatility was 72.5% a year in pounds, and it fell 74.2% from Dec 2017 to Jan 2019.
